content:
marta: Quick sync — postmortem action items from the 03/14 incident. Please confirm owners and realistic due dates by EOD so we can close the loop.

kevin: I have the db connection retry change (action #42). I can own it. Targeting 03/20. Will open PR today. :+1:

sunita: I'll take the alerting thresholds task (action #45). Need to sync with SRE on runbooks — aiming for 03/22.

ben: I can do the deploy rollback automation (action #47) but need 1 day of pairing with ops. proposed date 03/21.

marta: thx. I'm listing cross-team deps: 
- action #42 depends on eng-infra reviewing connection pool config
- action #45 needs SRE to approve runbook changes
- action #47 requires a small terraform change in infra repo

kevin: noted. tagging ops-bot for infra review queue. @ops-bot can you confirm ETA for infra review?

ops-bot: infra-review-queue: 2 items ahead, estimated review start 2026-03-18 09:30 UTC. Please include PR link.

kevin: thanks. I'll open the PR now: https://git.company/repo/pulls/1987

sunita: SRE (cc @ben) — can you review the runbook snippet I posted in the incident doc? small change: include warm-up queries before traffic ramp.

ben: saw it, will review by tomorrow 03/17.

marta: can owners confirm whether these dates are blockers for the broader rollout? we want to avoid delaying the Dedicated capacity release on 03/25.

kevin: not blockers. db retry change reduces error spikes but we can roll without it; low risk to postpone one week if needed.

sunita: alerting thresholds should be in before rollout to avoid noise during ramp — would prefer 03/22 as planned.

ben: rollback automation I'd mark as high priority for release day but can be optional pre-rollout. If pairing happens 03/18 we can still deliver by 03/21.

marta: ok good. final owners/dates: 
- action #42 (db retry): kevin — 2026-03-20
- action #45 (alert thresholds + runbook): sunita — 2026-03-22
- action #47 (deploy rollback automation + tf change): ben — 2026-03-21

marta: I'll update the postmortem with these assignments and add a verification step for 03/24 to confirm readiness.

kevin: ping me in the PR for any infra config questions.

sunita: I'll schedule a 30m async check-in with SRE for 03/18.

ben: adding a small checklist in the deploy repo: `rollback-tested`, `tf-plan-reviewed`, `runbook-linked`.

marta: thanks all. if anything slips, drop an update in this thread and include ETA. :calendar:
